app.name: Accel Business
app.tagline: Make your business digital in one sitting.
app.prototypeBanner: Prototype. All data is made up, and no real money, SMS or registry is involved.

home.title: The right business connection, in one sitting
home.intro: Tell us about your business. We'll suggest what fits, with one clear monthly price. Then finish verification and track your order on your phone.
home.point2: Verify with photos of your documents
home.point3: See every step, with no calls to chase
home.noticeBody: To suggest a bundle, we use what you tell us about your business, such as its type, city, size and needs. We keep the chat for 90 days.
home.noticeLlm: Chat messages are read by an AI service, Google Gemini, after we remove ID numbers. On its free tier, Google may use them to improve its products, so please don't share personal names or anything private.
home.noticeNoId: We don't ask for your name or any ID at this step.
home.noticeAgree: I agree to this use of my business details
home.noticeWithdraw: You can withdraw this at any time under My data.

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.llmDown: The advisor can't read typed messages just now. Tap an option, or use the short form.
advisor.assistHint: Businesses like yours often need a site check. A specialist can help at no cost, and you stay in control.
advisor.handedOffTitle: A person will take it from here
advisor.handedOffBody: Your details are saved. Someone from Accel Business will contact you, and you won't have to repeat anything.
advisor.blockedTitle: Not available for you right now
advisor.greeting: Namaste! I'm the Accel Business advisor. A few quick questions, and I'll suggest what fits your business with one clear price. You can type in any language.

ask.BUSINESS: What kind of business do you run?
ask.CITY: Which city or town is it in?
ask.CITY_TIER: I don't know that place yet. Which of these describes it best?
ask.SITES: How many sites or branches do you have?
ask.GSTIN: Do you have a GST registration, and is it active?
ask.FIBRE: Does fibre broadband reach your premises?
ask.NEEDS: Besides the internet connection, what would help your business? Pick any, or choose none.

note.CHANGED: You told me {from} before and {to} now, so I've used {to}. Tell me if that's wrong.
note.CHANGED_PLAIN: That's different from what you told me earlier, so I've used the latest. Tell me if that's wrong.
note.DISCOUNT: The price is the same for every business, and I can't change it. You can remove items below to bring the total down.
note.RULES_FIXED: Eligibility rules are fixed, and I can't change them for anyone.
note.OFF_TOPIC: I can only help with connectivity for your business.
note.COMPETITOR: I can only speak about Accel Business, so I won't compare with others.
note.SAVE_FOR_LATER: No rush. Your progress is saved, so you can come back whenever you like.
note.READY: Great. Use the button below to see your quote.
note.NOT_UNDERSTOOD: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that.
note.LLM_DOWN: I can't read typed messages just now, so please tap one of the options.
note.OFFER_PERSON: A person from Accel Business can help if you'd prefer. Use the button below.
note.UNKNOWN_PRODUCT_CLOSEST: We don't sell {thing}. The closest thing we have is {closest}.

recommend.summary: Here's what I'd suggest. It comes to {monthly} a month including GST, plus {setup} one-time setup, on a {contract}-month contract, installed in about {install} days.
recommend.empty: As things stand, I can't offer what you asked for. You can change your answers, or ask for a person.

kyc.title: Verify your business
kyc.consentIntro: To verify your business, we need your documents. Here's what happens to them.
kyc.consentCollect: What we collect: photos of your GST certificate (if you have one), Udyam certificate (optional), a signatory ID and an address proof, and the details we read from them.
kyc.consentWhy: Why: only to verify your business for this order, as required before activation.
kyc.consentWhere: Where: read on our own server and stored encrypted. They never go to the AI service.
kyc.consentRetention: How long: raw documents for 30 days after verification. Extracted details for the contract term.
kyc.consentRights: You can withdraw at any time under My data. We then stop and delete your documents.
kyc.consentAdult: I am 18 or over and authorised to act for this business
kyc.consentKyc: I agree to this use of my documents for verification
kyc.consentMarketing: Send me offers from Accel Business (optional)
kyc.consentRequired: Please tick both required boxes to continue.
kyc.contactIntro: We check this against the ID you upload.
kyc.contactName: Your full name, as on your ID
kyc.gstinHint: We'll read it from your certificate if you skip this.
kyc.businessNameHint: Needed because your bundle doesn't use a GST registration.
kyc.documentsIntro: Take a clear photo of each one, or choose a file. JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB.

doc.ADDRESS_PROOF: Address proof, such as a recent bill

docHint.GST_CERTIFICATE: Needed for your bundle, or if you have a GST registration

docStatus.BLURRED: Too blurry to read. Please take a sharper photo.
docStatus.UNREADABLE: We couldn't read this. Please try a clearer photo.
docStatus.WRONG_TYPE: This looks like a different document. Please upload the right one.
docStatus.PENDING_READ: Saved. We'll read it shortly, so you don't need to upload again.

uploadError.IMAGE_TOO_SMALL: This image is too small to read. Please take a closer photo.
uploadError.UNREADABLE_IMAGE: We couldn't open this image. Please try a different photo.

kyc.confirmBody: We may have misread it. Look at your certificate and enter the number exactly as printed.

verdict.VERIFIED: Verified. You can place your order.
verdict.RETAKE: We need a better copy of something.
verdict.VERIFICATION_PENDING: We've saved everything and will finish shortly. You can leave and come back.
verdict.MANUAL_REVIEW: A person will review a detail, usually within a working day. You can place your order now. It's held until they finish, and nothing is charged yet.
verdict.REJECTED: We can't complete verification for this bundle.

purposeBody.advisor_profile: Your business details and chat, used to suggest a bundle. Kept for 90 days.
purposeBody.kyc_verification: Your documents and the details read from them, used to verify your business.
purposeBody.marketing: Occasional offers. Never needed for anything else.

status.NOTICE_CHANGED: Our notice changed. Please review it again

effect.advisor_profile: This deletes your chat and any draft quote. An accepted quote stays.
effect.kyc_verification: This stops verification, deletes your documents and cancels any order not yet active. For an active order, only the raw documents go, and the details stay until the contract ends.
effect.service_updates: You'll stop getting status messages. Nothing else changes.
effect.marketing: You'll stop getting offers. Nothing else changes.
